section.title: Systems & Data
section.purpose: Inventory systems, sources of truth, ownership, duplication and integration boundaries.

questions.title: CRM / customer system
questions.prompt: What system stores leads, customers, opportunities or cases?
questions.recommendation: Inspect schema before asking the client.

questions.title: Email / calendar
questions.prompt: Which email and calendar platforms are used?
questions.recommendation: Include shared inboxes and scheduling tools.

questions.title: Documents / files
questions.prompt: Where do SOPs, contracts, proposals, templates and working files live?
questions.recommendation: Capture Drive, Dropbox, SharePoint, Notion, local drives, etc.

questions.title: Finance system
questions.prompt: What system holds invoices, payments, expenses, payroll or accounting?

questions.title: Support system
questions.prompt: Where are service questions, incidents and support requests handled?
questions.recommendation: Include inboxes if no ticket tool exists.

questions.title: Internal messaging
questions.prompt: Which channels carry operational coordination and decisions?

questions.title: Marketing stack
questions.prompt: Which systems send campaigns, run ads, publish content or capture attribution?

questions.title: Website / CMS
questions.prompt: What powers website, forms, ecommerce or portal?
questions.recommendation: Capture hosting, CMS, forms, analytics and code ownership.

questions.title: Databases / spreadsheets
questions.prompt: Which databases, spreadsheets or custom apps contain operational truth?

questions.title: Sources of truth
questions.prompt: For customer, project, invoice, employee, document and workflow status, which system is authoritative?

questions.title: Data conflicts
questions.prompt: Where is information duplicated, stale, inconsistent or manually re-entered?

questions.title: Integration access
questions.prompt: Which systems have APIs, webhooks, exports, MCP servers or service accounts?

questions.title: Owner control
questions.prompt: Who owns domains, repositories, hosting, databases, API accounts and credentials?

questions.title: Export / exit path
questions.prompt: Can essential data and configuration be exported without us?
questions.recommendation: No sovereignty pass without an exit path.
